question: a big piece of this deck is builyt around treasures, blood tokens, and a big piece of that is Jaws... ways to find and cast Jaws sooner!?!?!?? I need them!

contributions.slice: facts, branch list, context, pilot policy, three try screens, an in-memory Jaws target read
contributions.text:
# deck-doctor, study 043: Search for Glory on jaws-v1. Which cut, or none?
Question: Search for Glory ({2}{W} sorcery, any legendary) as a way to find Jaws ({3}{R}{R}) sooner. Screened under the `jaws-first` rule, one swap at a time, 10,000 paired games each. The goldfish could read every card in all three swaps.
**It does what he asked for.** Jaws in hand by T6 goes from 20.8% to 32.0-32.3% with tutoring, and found at all from 63.7% to 73-75%. In-memory `goldfish.run`, same seed. `try` does not print target rows.
**It loses on everything else the goldfish reads.** Each cut reads 1 better and 12-13 worse (Holm-corrected). The one better row is "cards handed to each opponent". The goldfish says a 3-mana do-nothing that turns into Jaws is worth less than the card cut.
| out (in: Search for Glory) | damage @T10 (212.1 now) | killed by T6 (18.9%) | extra cards by T8 (21.2) | other |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Willie Lumpkin, Postman | 194.3, -17.8 [-21.2, -14.4] | -1.1 pts [-1.3, -0.9] | -1.6 [-1.7, -1.4] | keep rule -0.9 pts; stall +0.8 pts |
| Brainstorm | 197.1, -15.0 [-18.2, -11.9] | -1.6 pts [-1.8, -1.3] | -1.7 [-1.8, -1.6] | keep rule and stall: no call; missed drop +1.1 pts; cards seen by T5 -0.5 |
| Faerie Mastermind | 195.9, -16.2 [-19.5, -13.0] | -1.3 pts [-1.6, -1.1] | -1.4 [-1.6, -1.3] | hoard @T6 no call; dead wheels @T5 +0.014 |
All three cuts cost about the same. Brainstorm costs the least damage and leaves the keep rule unchanged. Willie costs the most damage and is the only one that also costs unpriced defence.
**What the goldfish cannot see.** (1) Search for Glory can also fetch an answer or a body on demand: Venser, Inti, Shang-Chi or Kitsa, whichever the table calls for. (2) The defence Willie and Mastermind give, as an unblockable chump-flyer or a flash blocker. (3) Why Jaws matters at a real table: haste and trample through blockers, Blood on hit. The goldfish reads the ping and the Blood, but has no blockers to trample over.
(4) The earlier six-copy probe agrees with these screens. Damage @T10 read 165 under jaws-first against 179 under the default pick. Fetching Bard or Krang beats fetching Jaws on damage, so even the best Jaws line underperforms here.
**Call: NO CHANGE is the clear-upgrade answer.** On the "only clear, obvious upgrades" rule this fails: every speed row is worse, by about 7-8% damage @T10. The pilot's "find Jaws sooner" is real, and the swap buys +11 pts of Jaws by T6.
If he takes that trade on his own word, cut **Brainstorm**: smallest damage loss, no defence lost, keep rule intact. Willie stays, since he is a Human that draws and his defence is unpriced.
Better routes to Jaws are worth a study first. A cheaper or instant-speed tutor that reaches a creature, or more wheels, which his own sentence names ("wheels to find jaws").
Open: an A-table game log with Search for Glory proxied. The table, not the goldfish, decides whether early Jaws converts.

call.pilot_words: hold search for glory, keep jaws-first, push it...
